doc: Shared IKEA SKÅDIS interface parameters in mm. Grid: Skadis/spec/skadis_spec.md. Tab values are set by the fit test (Skadis/models/fit-test).

row.doc: row spacing; every other row is shifted by pitch / 2

slot_h.doc: slot length (vertical), ends rounded with slot_w / 2

board_t.doc: board thickness (fibreboard, varies by a few tenths)

tab_w.doc: hook tab width across the slot (fit test 4.4 / 4.6 / 4.8; Jan's boards, PETG, 2026-11: 4.8 best)

tab_gap.doc: gap between the part's back face and the tab lip = board thickness + play (fit test 5.1 / 5.3 / 5.5; 5.1 best, 5.3 a bit loose)

tab_shank_h.doc: height of the tab shank that sits in the slot

tab_lip_l.doc: how far the lip reaches down behind the board; also the lift needed to mount

tab_chamfer.doc: 45 deg chamfer on the tab ends, so the 13 mm tab passes the rounded 15 mm slot
